## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle alternative recension of [支謙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E8%AC%99) Zhī Qiān's *[Jiǔsè lù jīng (T181a)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0035)*, with slightly different textual transmission. Signature: 「吳月氏優婆塞支謙譯」. For the *Ruru-jātaka* narrative and bibliography, see [KR6b0035](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0035).

**Abstract**

T181b is the parallel-recension companion of T181a in the Sòng / Yuán canonical traditions. The translation is identical to T181a in substance; minor textual variation reflects manuscript transmission.
